_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

jurisdictionNote: Generic tribunal rules — applies to specialised quasi-judicial bodies constituted under the relevant parent statute. Tribunal-specific procedure and pecuniary jurisdiction are governed by that statute and any rules framed thereunder.

localRules: Pleadings and procedure are governed by the parent statute constituting the tribunal and rules framed thereunder.
Form of application, court fee, limitation, and verification follow the tribunal's procedural rules.
